description: R-PAR-1 PAR-FOLD, SQL-AGG-ORDER: With 4096 groups of three rows [2^53, 1, -2^53] interleaved in storage (FG; FGI adds an index on g), which Sum values occur over the groups and for which g (a derived table's own GROUP BY s), what is Sum of the 4096 group sums, what are the first eight groups with ORDER BY g and g DESC, what do the distinct values of Var per group look like, and what changes when the rows are fed in id DESC order? Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-fold2 opened read-only through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.
retentionNote: Designed r-par-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
